files.manifest.json: build identity: processingVersion, schemaVersion, dataMode, generatedAt, counts
files.processing-manifest.json: sha256 and size of every published file, plus the samples each task processed
files.sources.json: every upstream source with licence, citation, pinned revision and whether MOONATLAS modified it
files.global-stats.json: counts published verbatim by consumers; never recomputed downstream
files.crater-regions.json: one analyzed WAC tile per entry: footprint, projection, grid, provenance, detection count
files.craters.json: crater detections per region, as compact tuples expanded by the consumer
files.crater-tiles/<region>.json: per-tile detail: predicted and reference boxes for the inspector
files.ice-sectors.json: one analyzed polar patch per entry: raw statistics, rasters, anchor, provenance
files.ice-mosaics.json: one seamless mosaic per pole in its native polar stereographic grid
files.imp-regions.json: one analyzed NAC observation per entry: mask, predicted area, uncalibrated score, provenance
files.imp-observation-groups.json: repeat observations of one SomBench target, grouped for navigation only
files.discoveries.json: the curated subset, with the selection rule that produced each entry
files.previews/\u2026, overlays/\u2026: display rasters and masks; never read back as measurements

splits.external: not part of a benchmark split

origins.source_observation: an upstream image, input layer or tile metadata
origins.reference_annotation: published expert or catalogue work, shown for comparison only
origins.model_prediction: MOONATLAS's own inference with a published NASA-IBM LFM checkpoint
origins.derived_metric: a MOONATLAS computation over the above, always labelled as derived

rasterLevels.raw: the model's own output, unclipped and unsmoothed, in its own units
rasterLevels.display: a clipped, colour-mapped representation for viewing
